title: Stochastic hit-rate projections & unit economics (prefix cache) — Q2 2026 draft
content:
SUMMARY:
Draft workbook capturing probabilistic (stochastic) hit-rate scenarios for prefix and KV caches and the downstream impact on unit economics (cost per 1M tokens served). This is a working analysis: Monte Carlo sampling over session length / prefix reuse distributions to produce percentile estimates and payback times for engineering effort.

OBJECTIVE:
- Provide uncertainty-aware cost-saving estimates for product and infra tradeoffs.
- Surface the threshold hit-rate and cache effectiveness that justify enabling prefix caching by default for certain routes.

KEY ASSUMPTIONS (editable cells in sheet):
- Baseline compute cost per 1M tokens (hosted): $60.00
- Inference latency SLOs require keeping 90th pct <= 600ms (affects batching decisions)
- Average request tokens per call: 350 (Var: 50–1500)
- KV cache effectiveness for cached tokens: 85% (reduces token compute cost for cached tokens)
- Prefix cache effectiveness (if enabled) for repeated prefixes: 60%
- Additional per-request overhead for cache lookup: $0.0008
- Engineering effort to implement robust prefix cache + rollout (MVP): 4 engineer-weeks (cost assumed $40k fully-loaded)

METHODOLOGY NOTES:
- For each scenario we draw 50k Monte Carlo samples over: session length distribution, prefix reuse probability, prefix length distribution.
- Reuse modeled as Beta-Binomial: Beta(alpha,beta) fits observed prefix reuse hist from prod telemetry (alpha,beta tunable).
- We compute token-level savings per sample: cached_tokens * cache_effectiveness * token_unit_cost - lookup_overhead.
- Final metrics: mean savings %, 5th/95th percentiles, expected monthly $ savings at current traffic, payback months for implementation cost.

SAMPLE SCENARIO TABLE (spreadsheet rows):
Columns: Scenario | mean_hit_rate | 5th_pct | 95th_pct | avg_cached_tokens_per_req | baseline_cost_per_1M | post_cache_cost_per_1M | savings_$ | savings_% | monthly_traffic_1M_token_equiv | monthly_savings_$ | payback_months
Row: Conservative | 0.08 | 0.03 | 0.15 | 28 | $60.00 | $55.84 | $4.16 | 6.93% | 120 | $499.20 | 80.3
Row: Realistic | 0.18 | 0.11 | 0.28 | 63 | $60.00 | $46.92 | $13.08 | 21.8% | 120 | $1569.60 | 25.5
Row: Optimistic | 0.36 | 0.24 | 0.53 | 128 | $60.00 | $34.12 | $25.88 | 43.13% | 120 | $3105.60 | 12.9
Row: Route-specific-high-prefix | 0.52 | 0.40 | 0.66 | 210 | $60.00 | $22.90 | $37.10 | 61.83% | 50 | $1855.00 | 21.6
Row: Worst-case (no reuse) | 0.005 | 0.000 | 0.02 | 2 | $60.00 | $59.90 | $0.10 | 0.17% | 120 | $12.00 | 3333

FORMULAS (documented, not live):
- avg_cached_tokens_per_req = mean_hit_rate * avg_request_tokens
- post_cache_cost_per_1M = baseline_cost_per_1M * (1 - (mean_hit_rate * cache_effectiveness)) + (lookup_overhead * (1M / avg_request_tokens))
- savings_$ = baseline_cost_per_1M - post_cache_cost_per_1M
- payback_months = engineering_implementation_cost / monthly_savings_$  (if monthly_savings_$ > 0 else >> large)

INTERPRETATION / TAKEAWAYS (working bullets):
- Small mean hit-rates (e.g., <10%) generally do not justify global prefix caching due to lookup overhead and engineering cost; however, route-specific high-reuse paths (search/assistant-templates) show compelling ROI.
- For mid-range reuse (15–30%), expected payback is on order of 6–30 months depending on traffic volume and cache effectiveness.
- Optimistic outcomes (high reuse + high effectiveness) reduce per-token cost dramatically (>40%), but these require both stable user patterns and careful eviction/kvcap tuning.

SENSITIVITY & RISK NOTES:
- Sensitive to avg_request_tokens: lower tokens per request amplify per-request lookup overhead relative to savings.
- Cache effectiveness uncertainty dominates: quantize as low/med/high in product experiments.
- Implementation risks: correctness (stale prefixes), memory usage on dedicated pools, increased tail-latency for cold misses — include SLO guardrails in rollout.

ACTIONS & RECOMMENDATIONS (next steps):
1) Run a targeted experiment on two high-candidate routes (Search suggestion, Support macro completions) to measure real-world prefix reuse and effective cache hit rate. Owner: Marco Díaz. Ticket: JIRA-OPT-789.
2) Build a small server-side simulator (single-node) to reproduce Monte Carlo with customer traffic trace replay. Deliverable: CSV timeseries + distribution plots. Owner: Eleanor Chen.
3) Add a canary feature flag that enables prefix caching only for 5% of traffic and automatically collects per-request metrics: lookup-time, cache-hit (bool), tokens-saved. Add per-flag breakdown in Console.
4) If experiment median hit-rate > 18% for route X, enable prefix cache for that route with a 4-week canary, else fall back to KV-only.

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF:
- Which teams own the routing policy changes? (ping eng-infra + serving-runtime)
- Need to estimate memory footprint per prefix entry: sample quota and TTL; add this to cost model (RAM cost vs GPU cost).
- Consider hybrid approach: KV for long-lived objects + prefix cache for short, highly-reused prefixes.

LINKS / REFERENCES:
- Confluence design draft: CONFLUENCE-1234-prefix-cache-design
- Monte Carlo notebook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/blob/main/notebooks/prefix_cache_montecarlo.ipynb
- Slack thread: #optimize-prefix-cache (see thread pinned messages)

QUICK TABLE FOR PRODUCT DECISION (editable):
- Route | traffic_rank_pct | expected_hit_rate | expected_monthly_savings | recommend_flag
- Search-suggestions | 4% | 0.38 | $1,880 | enable-canary
- Assistant-macros | 2% | 0.26 | $620 | enable-canary
- Bulk-batch-exports | 0.5% | 0.06 | $48 | no-action

NOTES ON PRESENTATION:
- Final deliverable should include 3 charts: CCDF of savings, payback-months heatmap (traffic x hit-rate), and distribution of post-cache cost per 1M tokens.
- Keep the sheet lightweight: raw samples stored in hidden tabs, summary table at top for PM/Finance review.

END OF DRAFT.

(Work-in-progress: will iterate after route-level telemetry and small canary run.)
